tracks.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 1: Kereshmeh
tracks.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Kereshmeh in Bayat-e Esfahan, Chahargah, Mahur, Nava. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

tracks.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 2: Hazin
tracks.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Hazin in Chahargah, Mahur, Nava, Segah, Shur. Its tonic is its own voted finalis. Tonic named F#: Alizadeh's setar sits within about 20 cents of A440 across his radif albums, so this finalis is a real F sharp, not a natural note on an instrument tuned away from A440.
